description: Allowlist for the ENGLISH->foreign render-fidelity gate (src/multilingual/render-fidelity.test.ts). Each entry is a corpus pattern id mapped to the languages whose rendered surface loses an action or a role from the English reference when parsed back. A NEW failing (pattern,language) pair outside this list, or an allowlisted pair that now passes, both fail the gate. Shrinks only: deleting an entry is how a renderer fix is completed. Regenerate with tools/regen-render-fidelity-baseline.ts.
